# Upper Fort Dental

> Upper Fort Dental is a downtown Winnipeg dental practice offering comprehensive preventive, cosmetic, restorative, and family dentistry services led by Dr. Carly Hamilton.

Located at 108-305 Broadway in downtown Winnipeg, Upper Fort Dental provides a full range of dental care including emergency services, Invisalign orthodontics, and specialized treatments for patients of all ages. The practice accepts insurance, financing options, and the Canadian Dental Care Plan.

## Core Services

- [Services](https://upperfortdental.com/services): Upper Fort Dental services including cosmetic, restorative, pediatric dentistry, and Invisalign.
- [Family Dentistry](https://upperfortdental.com/family-dentistry): Family dentistry services for all ages with preventive and cosmetic care at Upper Fort Dental.
- [Crowns and Fillings](https://upperfortdental.com/crowns-and-fillings): Dental crowns and fillings restoration services using composite resin at Upper Fort Dental.
- [Invisalign](https://upperfortdental.com/invisalign): Invisalign clear aligners with SmartTrack and SmartForce technology at Upper Fort Dental.
- [Emergency Dentistry](https://upperfortdental.com/emergency-dentistry): Emergency dentistry services for toothaches and dental injuries at Upper Fort Dental.
